selection: Original in-the-wild images only; one candidate per credited author; unique original image MD5 and Flickr URL; exclude originals used for multiple aligned faces. Geometric face-size and source-resolution eligibility only, followed by direct GPT visual review. No inferred personal identity; authors are photographers, not subjects.
license: Preserve individual original Flickr license and author. FFHQ metadata CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Current local research only.
extension: First 350 candidates immutable; appended distinct authors from the same seeded shuffled pool to compensate unavailable and visually excluded photographs.
current_download_policy: Current public Flickr photo-page listed files only. Cached early acquisitions retain the largest publicly listed size; subsequent acquisitions prefer the largest non-original rendition with long edge <=2048, short edge >=800 and long edge >=1024. No crops or aligned FFHQ images. The original-size endpoint often returned HTTP429; publicly listed high-resolution renditions were available. Single worker with 2-second spacing, honoring Retry-After on 429.
